description: Size-built cmix21 sidecar direct/page model. Same decoder-built MediaWiki sidecar contexts as cmix21_sidecar_direct_page_v1, rebuilt with section garbage collection and a stripped size-oriented binary so the decompressor payload is smaller.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary

SIDECAR_WRT_LEARN.reason: Archive tie versus size-page baseline, with larger packaged binary.

SIDECAR_BYTE_MODEL_SIDECAR_BYTE_SPLIT.reason: Archive regression and larger packaged binary.

O2_size_gc_strip.reason: Archive improves by 3 bytes but the packaged binary grows by 109829 bytes versus the promoted -Os build.

O3_size_gc_strip.reason: Archive regression versus the promoted -Os build and much larger packaged binary.

SIDECAR_EXTRA_MATCH.reason: Archive improves by 1 byte but the packaged binary grows by 141 bytes versus the promoted -Os build.

verdict: Promote as the best cmix21-sidecar packaging and raw-prefix archive gate, but not as the 250k scored leader because fx2_sidecar_wrt_learn_v1 has a much smaller program payload.
